Axiom:
A BLOCKER entry in Execution Log (line containing `🛑` and `BLOCKED`) remains ACTIVE until `## Blocker Trail` carries a matching resolution line — `✅ RESOLVED (Round / )` (D-20, B2-19). The back-reference is what pairs it to the right occurrence; a resolution is NEVER appended inline in the Execution Log itself, so it works whether or not that Round has already closed.
Orchestrator consumes the `[BLOCKERS]` section already returned by `sdd-task `. `blockers: none` is clear; each `blockers: ACTIVE ` entry is classified through the typed checkpoint as recoverable technical, spec-goal conflict, or external authority. Active history never implies an operator pause by itself. Do not spend a second check call or reconstruct it.
Resolution authorship: the `## Blocker Trail` entry MUST cite the specific environmental change or decision that resolved the blocker (e.g. "tsconfig moduleResolution fixed", "operator chose option B"). Empty resolution text → audit treats as fabricated and may re-flag.
Append-only discipline: never edit or remove the original `🛑 BLOCKED` line, and never hand-edit `## Blocker Trail` — only `npx gennady sdd-log resolved` writes it. The blocker history is part of the artifact.
